contea di ritrovamento: Greater London (Inghilterra e Galles)

A complete Roman copper-alloy nummus of Constantine I (AD 306-337) as Divus dating to the period AD 337-340 (Reece period 17). No legend; Emperor to right in quadriga; the hand of God reaches down to him. Probably mint of Trier. Mintmark: -//T[...] RIC VIII, p. 143, no. 44 or 68. Obverse: Veiled head right.
